method: Pont2006-inspired time-averaging of joint box+event-baseline residuals. White reference generated and refitted at same timestamps/errors/design. No new clock/duration/flux access. Diagnostic uncertainty sensitivity, not calibrated coverage or FAP.
beta: max(1, observed RMS of bin means / RMS of same statistic over white residual simulations); take maximum over all declared widths and offsets. Formal white errors retain original residual-scale floor. Global beta rescales conditional depth error.
bins: Equal-count bins N=round(width/cadence), min2; split at event boundary or gap>1.5 median cadence. Offset floor(offset*N) independently per segment; discard incomplete bins. Never bridge gaps. Residuals include in-transit points with fitted box removed.
event_influence: Refit each single-event omission; recompute all betas and inflated errors.
tests: Noiseless zero and +/-1000ppm injection recovery on every design. Deterministic 200-replicate iid and AR1(phi=.85) simulations on representative sector90 with resets per contiguous segment; evaluate beta response and fixed-depth error scatter. All failures retained.
